SmartZip Pro: Your Complete Archive Solution for iOS

Unleash the power of professional file management on your iPhone and iPad. Extract any compressed file, preview contents instantly, create secure archives, and keep your device organized—all with the speed and simplicity iOS users expect.

WHY SMARTZIP PRO STANDS OUT

UNIVERSAL FORMAT SUPPORT
Open ZIP, RAR, 7Z, TAR, GZIP, BZIP2, XZ, and ISO files instantly. Whether it's an email attachment, cloud download, or Files app import, SmartZip Pro handles them all with pro-grade reliability.

INSTANT PREVIEW WITHOUT EXTRACTION 
Browse photos, watch videos, play audio, and read documents directly inside archives. No need to extract everything first—save time and storage space with smart previewing that just works.

CREATE ENCRYPTED ZIP FILES 
Compress files from Photos or Files app into password-protected ZIP archives with AES-256 encryption. Share confidential documents securely with teams or clients.

POWERFUL FILE MANAGER 
More than just an unzipper—it's your mobile file command center.
- Rename, duplicate, move, and share files with ease
- View detailed metadata: size, creation date, file type
- Organize archives like folders with intuitive controls
- Extract specific items or entire archives to your workspace

RECLAIM YOUR SPACE 
Unique to SmartZip Pro: our Cache Cleaner analyzes temporary files and helps you free up valuable storage with one tap. Keep your app lean and your device clutter-free.

SMART SEARCH & DISCOVERY 
Find files instantly by name or type. Filter through large archives quickly with intelligent search that understands your needs. Perfect for managing course materials, work documents, or media collections.

DESIGNED FOR iOS

- Native Files app integration for seamless workflow
- Import from Photos library with full album support
- Share via AirDrop, Messages, Mail, and more
- Optimized for iPhone and iPad with intuitive touch controls
- Works offline—no internet required for extraction or preview
- Clean, ad-free interface focused on your productivity

SUPPORTED FORMATS

Decompress: ZIP, RAR, 7Z, TAR, GZIP, BZIP2, XZ, ISO
Compress: ZIP (with optional AES-256 password protection)
Preview: Images (JPG, PNG, GIF, HEIC), Videos (MP4, MOV), Audio (MP3, WAV), Documents (PDF, TXT, HTML)

quotes.text:
Hi HN,

I’m an independent iOS developer and wanted to share SmartZip Pro, a file compression and extraction app I built for iPhone and iPad.

The goal was simple: make archive handling on iOS feel native, fast, and professional—without ads, clutter, or unnecessary friction.

What it does:

Extracts ZIP, RAR, 7Z, TAR, GZIP, BZIP2, XZ, ISO, and more

Creates ZIP archives, including AES-256 encrypted ZIPs

Lets you preview files directly inside archives (images, video, audio, documents) without extracting first

Works seamlessly with Apple’s Files app

Supports common file operations: rename, move, search, share, AirDrop

Why I built it:
On desktop platforms, archive tools are taken for granted. On iOS, many solutions feel either limited or over-designed. I wanted something that respects Apple platform conventions, performs well on large archives, and stays out of the way.

App Store link:
https://apps.apple.com/us/app/smartzip-pro-zip-rar-7z/id6756837927

I’d genuinely appreciate feedback from the HN community—especially around performance, UX expectations on iOS, or missing workflows you care about.

Thanks for reading.

— Eric
